text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"longer sentences with clearer paragraphing","quality":"organization","description":"The essay presents ideas in a more structured way, with an introduction, body paragraphs, and a conclusion that are easier to follow."},{"evidence":"\"First,\" \"Then,\" \"Lastly,\"","quality":"cohesive transitions","description":"The essay uses more explicit sequencing language to connect its points and guide the reader through the argument."},{"evidence":"\"school should help not control students\"","quality":"sentence control","description":"The essay shows somewhat better control of sentence structure, with fewer severely broken constructions than the other essay."},{"evidence":"\"some students have a lot of homework, project, tests\"","quality":"idea development","description":"The essay develops its reasons with more extended explanation and examples rather than remaining at a highly fragmentary level."},{"evidence":"\"This is why extracurricular activities decision should made by families not by schools.\"","quality":"argument coherence","description":"The essay maintains a more consistent main claim across paragraphs and returns to it more clearly in the conclusion."}]}
